metadata.description: Plugins and mods for Claude Code, shared as-is.

plugins.name: turn-receipt
plugins.description: A receipt beneath each answer: the turn's tokens and cost in US dollars, its subagents' share, and the session's running total. Keeps a monthly tally apart from the short-lived session records. Commands: /receipt shows and saves this session, /receipt-total sums the kept sessions, /receipt-month shows a month's tally, /receipt-clear drops the session records and keeps the months.
